programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Science Of Sabotage'. The chefs make a hearty, high-end dinner in 45 minutes for a construction crew using only the crew's lunches, bent pans and construction tools.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S32/E4 - Family Teams'. Guy Fieri invites three families to show off their home cooking and shopping skills. They'll cook a family favourite using items on the 'F is for Family' grocery list.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S27/E11 - Starch Madness'. The gang's epic, starch-filled menu leaves no carb behind! It starts with beer cheese soup in a bread bowl, then a pierogi pizza, and a fettuccine Alfredo pie.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S49/E8 - Taco Brawl'. Four talented chefs are challenged to make creative taco dishes. A frantic first round leads to some missteps in the kitchen, which could prove costly.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S1/E10 - Freeze Please'. Four chefs create amazingly frosty desserts, but will they finish in time? In the second basket, a Japanese egg dish and an oversized ice cream treat are in play.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S1/E11 - Cake Stakes'. Four bakers must create fantastic cakes in record time. In round one they must adapt quickly. Then they uncover a jumbo-sized ingredient in the second basket.

programme.title: Chopped Sweets
programme.desc: 'S1/E12 - Breakfast For Dessert'. Four chefs attempt to make breakfast-themed desserts. The baskets include a coffee drink, a cleverly designed candy and waffle dough.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S28/E14 - Global Food Fanatics'. Guy Fieri invites three food-obsessed home cooks to share the international flavours they grew up on, starting with their signature global dish.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E1 - Pierogis, Pork And Pizza'. Guy Fieri checks out a Florida sandwich shop with a taste of Peru and a pierogi palace in Philadelphia. And a North Dakota pizza joint serves up meatballs.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S34/E2 - Takeout: Best Of The West'. Guy and Hunter Fieri cook up some sizzling takeout with a crazy burger from Phoenix and handmade sausages from Portland, Oregon.

programme.title: Chopped Junior
programme.desc: 'S5/E4 - Chocoholics'. The junior chefs battle it out to impress the judges with their chocolate skills. They have to add the sweet taste to their savoury entrées. Who will come out on top?

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S31/E6 - Beat The Judges: Spicy'. Guy invites three spice experts to prove just how heated things can get. Which contestant will take on an all-star judge in the ultimate spicy showdown?

programme.title: Ready Jet Cook
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Soups'. Jet Tila cooks up two noodle soups that are near and dear to his heart, a quick beef pho and Japanese spicy miso ramen.

programme.title: Ready Jet Cook
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Shrimp'. Jet Tila makes shrimp the star when he stir-fries up a flavour-packed kung pao shrimp and his salt and pepper shrimp with veggie-loaded fried rice.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S19/E9 - A Healthy Helping'. The gang serves up healthy and delicious recipes, including Katie Lee's beef, bean and veggie burgers. And, actress Teri Hatcher stops by to make broccoli cakes.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S39/E6 - Tortas, Tomatoes And Tequila'. Guy Fieri dives into killer culinary and cocktails, from an over-the-top Mexican spot in San Antonio, TX, to a hidden speakeasy in Brunswick, GA.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S53/E3 - Buzzworthy Bizarre Baskets'. The basketeers outdid themselves for this special competition, featuring mandatory ingredients that leave the chefs shaking their heads in disbelief.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S43/E5 - Funkalicious'. Guy Fieri gets funky with jerk chicken in California, duck confit banh mi in Nevada, and a lion's mane sandwich in North Carolina.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S43/E6 - Buns, Burgers, And Bolognese'. Guy Fieri digs into braised beef noodles in Sacramento, a mighty meat sauce in Palm Beach Gardens, and a bodacious bean burger in San Jose.

programme.title: 24 In 24: Last Chef Standing
programme.desc: 'S3/E6 - Shift 6: Risk-Taking'. The remaining six weary chefs face their toughest test yet in a shift that's all about risk-taking, as judge Marcel Vigneron decides their fate.

programme.title: Candy Land
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - A Gift Fit For A King'. The final two teams face off with their gifts to impress King Kandy of Candy Land and win $25,000. The cake and sugar artists must include a tasting element.

programme.title: Cooking For Love
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Mummy's Boy'. Nik and Sarah treat a hardworking single mother to a surprise dinner. The Western fusion themed meal features sambal spaghetti and slow-roasted duck.

programme.title: Cutthroat Kitchen: Knives Out
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Freezer Burned'. The chefs must create a hearty French entrée and side with frozen ingredients and shared access to only one oven, stovetop and fryer.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S37/E5 - Pick-Me-Ups'. In Boise, Idaho, Guy Fieri samples flavourful sandwiches and empanadas. Then, a funky joint in Savannah serves up real-deal wood-fired pizza and bagels.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S37/E6 - Seafood, Spice And Soul'. Guy Fieri checks out seaside snacks, global spice, and Southern soul. In Georgia, he visits a Tybee Island joint serving gourmet hot dogs!

programme.desc: 'S8/E6'. Ian gets creative with a few vintage ranch treasures and a wild idea. His mind is set on building a vintage house car, Ian brings in some high-powered help and dives deep.

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: 'S12/E5'. South Africa's premier auto expo at Montecasino features a Rocket Bunny RX7, custom VW Caddy, Fast & Furious S2000 replica, plus night market vibes, dance battles, and celebrity guests.

programme.title: The Bike Show
programme.desc: 'S26/E31'. On The Bike Show this week, a Honda Transalp with a clutch lever that's optional, an improved Kawasaki Z900 naked bike, and KTM's most badass adventure machine.

programme.title: How to Build a Dream Car
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Brabus transforms Mercedes-Benz models into 900-hp luxury supercars. German engineering, custom parts, and extreme performance come at prices up to 1 million.

programme.title: Isle of Man TT HL
programme.desc: 'S2/E2'. Dean Harrison dominates qualifying before rain halts racing, revisiting his 2025 Superstock double, Davey Todd's first TT win and John McGuinness' 30th TT.

programme.title: Desert Collectors
programme.desc: 'S3/E7'. Covid has hit small businesses including Phil's Imaginiarum. With a little help from Jorja, Phil sells some gear, Nigel and Jorja buy some gear. With a lot of laughs thrown in.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: 'S26/E31'. Comparing hybrid and petrol Corolla ownership costs, evaluating repaired Mercedes-Benz C200 buying risks, and asking if EV ownership is practical without home charging for buyers.

programme.title: Bangers & Cash
programme.desc: 'S4/E11'. Derek picks up Swedish models, a Saab 96L and Volvo P1800ES. A British AC Aceca sports car comes up for sale and a pooch makes an audacious auction bid for an American hot dog van.

programme.title: Trace, Track, Get My Car Back

programme.title: Cape Route Rally

programme.title: Just To See How Far It Is
